verdict.rationale: Docs confirm cards are created via a single API call (create a paymentInstrument, virtual or physical) and card can be activated/suspended via API, but there's no evidence that PAN/CVV/expiry are returned programmatically at issuance, nor any mention of a self-serve sandbox-to-live path without a sales/onboarding process. missing for 10: explicit PAN/CVV/expiry retrieval in the create response, evidence of self-serve go-live without sales cycle.
